The channel doesn't say what the guard did between then and kiosk 1 coming back. The next guard mention is at 11:03, when Mateo reported that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836.

The channel doesn't record anything else about the guard's activity, so anything more would need the guard's own account or the incident log (INC-4821).
